macros.name: restorechapter
macros.doc: The \restorechapter command resets any subsequent \chapter commands to their default behaviour.

macros.name: simplechapter
macros.doc: The \simplechapter[⟨name⟩] command modifies any subsequent \chapter commands so that the result looks like that of \chapter* except that the chapter number is put on the same line as the title and the value of \simplechapterdelim is typeset immediately after the number.

macros.name: tocbibname
macros.doc: This holds the text for the Bibliography heading.

macros.name: tocetcmark
macros.doc: In this package, the marks for the ToC, LoF...headers are specified via the command \tocetcmark{⟨head⟩}.

macros.name: tocotherhead
macros.doc: \tocotherhead{⟨name⟩} is the user command to set the heading command ⟨name⟩ (without the backslash).

macros.name: tocsection
macros.doc: The \tocsection command modifies \toc@section to typeset using \section instead of \section*.
